_doc: Pass/fail requirements for the shoulder exo. Each has ONE judge outside the design pipeline. Thresholds marked proposed are not yet confirmed by the user. See REQUIREMENTS.md.

R1.name: Proximity: covered skin 2-10 mm from the metal while following

R2.name: No part enters the body, any frame of any clip

R3.name: Follows the arm (frames tracked, not held at a limit)

R5.name: At most 4 DOF (3R + sliding cuff, or 4R)

R6.name: No interference between parts that move relative to each other

R7.name: Every custom part is one valid closed solid
R7.judge: judge/part_validity.py (OCC BRepCheck on the exported STEP)

R9.name: Strength: SF >= 1.5 at 25 N.m worst direction; deflection and fatigue bounded
R9.judge: independent FEA (CalculiX) - only the in-house hex8 study exists (pipeline/conformal/thin_study)

R10.name: Base mounts to a thorax-fixed back plate; shoulder-centre misalignment bounded
R10.judge: OpenSim (Seth 2016 thoracoscapular model): today the base is modelled scapula-fixed

R11.name: Interface pressure under ISO/TS 15066 body-region limits
R11.judge: coupled human-exo contact sim (MuJoCo/Drake) then pressure film / FSRs on a prototype

R12.name: CAD standard: G2 surfaces, flat seats under every seat, no visible screws or seams

R13.name: Manufacturable
R13.judge: supplier DFM review + quote (CNC Ti / 7075, SLM AlSi10Mg)

R14.name: Generalises: holds on motions and body shapes never used to design it
R14.judge: held-out OpenCap / AMASS clips and SMPL-X bodies (data/raw)

R15.name: Works on real bodies
R15.judge: printed prototype on the user + one very different body: OpenCap reach vs bare arm, zero skin-contact on FSR strips
